Assistant (4.9s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Ms Schmidt?

User (6.4s): Yes, this is Hannah Schmidt.

Assistant (12.4s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (13.4s): April twenty-eighth nineteen ninety-three.

Assistant (26.0s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (27.1s): Three three one seven.

Assistant (43.1s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 5512 has a past-due amount of 180.00, which is 5 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (44.0s): I already paid that in the app this morning.

Assistant (56.3s): Payments can take one business day to appear. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
